notes: Site: IKEA UAE (ikea.com/ae/en), sibling of IKEA UK (SR92), IKEA DE (SR107), IKEA France (SR140), all on the same global platform. Tier 1 (direct curl HTTP fetch, no Playwright needed) reached https://www.ikea.com/ae/en/cat/best-sellers/ directly (HTTP 200, no block; robots.txt checked, no Claude-specific disallow). Page H1 'Top seller', <title> 'Discover Top Seller Products for Home Furniture In UAE - IKEA', meta description 'Explore IKEA top and best seller products online! Browse our wide collection of furniture, home decor, storage solutions, wardrobes and more.' - a genuine bestseller/popularity merchandising concept with a real browsable/filterable product grid (matches UK/DE/FR sibling classification of the equivalent /cat/best-sellers/ page). The page shows department 'chips' (price buckets, subcategory facets etc.) - inspected their hrefs directly (e.g. https://www.ikea.com/ae/en/cat/best-sellers/?filters=f-online-sellable:true,f-price-buckets:PRICE_0_10000&sort=RATING) and confirmed these are query-param filters of the SAME base /cat/best-sellers/ listing, not distinct site-curated PLPs, so no sub-categories were invented; only the canonical unfiltered URL is emitted. SSR HTML independently shows '987 items' (filter-panel header) and 'Showing 24 of 987 results' with progress max=987 (results-list footer) - both consistent, sourced directly from raw HTML (no Playwright render needed since the count is present in the initial SSR payload). No other Bestsellers-labelled entry point found via candidate slug probing (/cat/top-sellers/, /cat/popular/ not tried further once canonical page confirmed) or homepage link scan. Did not need Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3).
